description: Hi! I'm Eyenase. I'm passionate about space storytelling to inspire future engineers. I use NASA open data and I'm looking for developers, designers, or data lovers to join my team. Ping me if you want to team up!
summary:
What happens when a kid who failed physics meets an expert who truly understands kids? That's what our project is about!

We created Olim, an interactive animated story about NASA's Opportunity rover. Our main characters, Ethan and Zoe, are kids who know nothing about space, so they stand in for the real kids watching and choosing. Their guide is Ellias, a ghost from the Apollo era. Players choose which questions to ask, and each answer leads to a new question.

We believe storytelling means making hard things simple. Our story runs on curiosity, the same thing great scientists rely on, so learning feels fun, not boring.

A child watching today could become a scientist tomorrow. Our team of very different young people made the characters, drawings and animation by hand. In the artwork that needed imagination, we used AI as little as possible; we used AI mainly to build simple simulations, such as how long a signal takes to reach Mars.

HOW TO PLAY: Press START. When a question appears, move the golden orb toward your answer (A = left, D = right, S = the question you skipped). Confirm with Enter, a tap, or controller A.
details:
Olim is a web-based interactive animated story. It plays on computers, phones and with game controllers, with no install needed.

HOW IT WORKS

The story begins with hand-drawn 2D animation: two kids who failed physics open a box in the attic and meet Ellias, a ghost janitor from the Apollo era who acts like a space expert. He takes them by bus to the museum, where Chapter One: Opportunity begins. The characters then talk in front of the rover, with backgrounds that change to match the topic (our drawings and NASA/JPL images). Players move a golden orb to choose questions (left, right, or down for the question they skipped). Each answer opens a new branch: why Opportunity used solar power, why commands take 4-24 minutes to reach

Story, characters and script: written by our team in Thai, then translated to English with help from Claude (AI).

ElevenLabs (AI): voices, music and sound effects. Claude (AI): fact-checking, translation, web app code and simple simulations. Story, characters, drawings and animation were made by hand by our team.
